description: Move an item to a milestone. Move an item on the trail into a milestone, or out of every milestone with `milestoneId: null`. The item stays on the trail and keeps its discovery record; only the milestone it counts toward changes. An item that is not on the trail is `404`, and so is a milestone of another …

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

itemHandle.description: A queue item's per-project number (e.g. `12`, `#12` also accepted) or its full id.

milestoneId.description: The milestone to move the item into (`TrailMilestone.id`), or `null` to take it out of every milestone.
